```plato
//==
// # Text
//
// Reading numbers from text. The host half is in `intrinsics.library.plato`
// (`IsNumberText`, `NumberFromText`, `IsIntegerText`, `IntegerFromText`); the functions
// here return it as a record the caller checks.

library Text
{
    // Reads a real number in the P21 forms: optional sign, digits, optional point and
    // digits, optional exponent E or e with an optional sign. "1.", ".5" and "1.E-06"
    // are accepted; anything else, and a value that rounds to infinity, has Ok false
    // and Value 0. The value is correctly rounded, so every runtime agrees bit for bit.
    // Witness: ParseNumber("1.5E1") is (15, true); ParseNumber("1e") is (0, false).
    ParseNumber(s: String): NumberParse
        => NumberParse(s.NumberFromText, s.IsNumberText);
```
